items.title: Beyond Compaction: Structured Context Eviction for Long-Horizon Agents
items.title_zh: 超越压缩：面向长时程智能体的结构化上下文驱逐
items.summary: Context Window Lifecycle annotates an agent's trajectory as typed, dependency-linked episodes and uses a deterministic, LLM-free policy to evict content in priority order when a token budget is exceeded. A single agent session completed 89 sequential tasks across 80 million tokens with no measurable accuracy degradation relative to per-task isolated sessions.

items.title: SURGE: SuperBatch Unified Resource-efficient GPU Encoding for Heterogeneous Partitioned Data
items.title_zh: SURGE：面向异构分区数据的超高批量、资源高效 GPU 嵌入编码
items.summary: SURGE is a streaming GPU encoding system deployed in production to generate embeddings for more than 800 million texts across 40,000 logical partitions. On 10 million texts with four NVIDIA L4 GPUs it delivered 26,413 texts per second while using 12.6x less memory than fixed-size batching.

items.title: A Knowledge-Driven LLM-Based Decision-Support System for Explainable Defect Analysis and Mitigation Guidance in Laser Powder Bed Fusion
items.title_zh: 知识驱动的 LLM 决策支持系统：激光粉末床熔融中的可解释缺陷分析与缓解指导
items.summary: The system combines an ontology-structured knowledge base of 27 LPBF defect types, organized into hierarchical categories and causal relationships, with LLM reasoning for fuzzy natural-language retrieval, literature-supported explanations and mitigation guidance. The fully integrated configuration reached a macro-average F1 of 0.808 on a literature-derived dataset, with substantial inter-rater agreement.

items.title: Claw-Eval-Live: A Live Agent Benchmark for Evolving Real-World Workflows
items.title_zh: Claw-Eval-Live：面向持续演化真实工作流的实时智能体基准
items.summary: Claw-Eval-Live is a live benchmark for workflow agents that refreshes a signal layer across releases and logs task execution, addressing benchmarks that freeze a task set at release time and grade only the final response. It drew 40 Hugging Face daily-paper upvotes.

items.title: GeoContra: From Fluent GIS Code to Verifiable Spatial Analysis with Geography-Grounded Repair
items.title_zh: GeoContra：从流畅 GIS 代码到可验证空间分析的地理约束修复
items.summary: GeoContra represents each LLM-driven GIS task as an executable geospatial contract and applies static rule inspection, runtime validation and semantic verification, feeding violations into a bounded repair loop. Across 7,079 real geospatial tasks, it raised spatial correctness from 47.6% to 77.5% for DeepSeek-V4 and from 57.7% to 81.5% for Kimi-K2.5.

items.title: Compared to What? Baselines and Metrics for Counterfactual Prompting
items.title_zh: 与什么相比？反事实提示的基线与指标
items.summary: The authors argue that counterfactual-prompting effects are compound treatments bundling the targeted factor with incidental surface variation, and propose comparing targeted interventions against paraphrase-induced changes through statistical testing. On MedQA, a 14.9% flip rate from changing patient gender was statistically indistinguishable from the 14.1% rate induced by paraphrasing.

items.title: FlashRT: Towards Computationally and Memory Efficient Red-Teaming for Prompt Injection and Knowledge Corruption
items.title_zh: FlashRT：更省算力与内存的提示注入与知识污染红队测试
items.summary: Pennsylvania State University researchers introduce FlashRT, a framework that makes optimization-based prompt injection and knowledge corruption attacks against long-context LLMs such as Gemini-3.1-Pro and Qwen-3.5 faster and more memory-efficient, enabling more scalable security evaluation.

items.title: Heterogeneous Scientific Foundation Model Collaboration
items.title_zh: 异构科学基础模型协同
items.summary: Researchers introduce Eywa, a heterogeneous agentic framework that pairs language-based reasoning with domain-specific scientific foundation models instead of forcing every problem through a language interface. It drew 174 Hugging Face upvotes.

items.title: InteractWeb-Bench: Can Multimodal Agent Escape Blind Execution in Interactive Website Generation?
items.title_zh: InteractWeb-Bench：多模态智能体能否摆脱交互式网站生成中的“盲执行”？
items.summary: InteractWeb-Bench is presented as the first multimodal interactive benchmark for website generation under non-expert low-code conditions, targeting semantic misalignment between users and coding agents through diverse user agents and an interactive execution environment.
